$schema_notes: Benchmark prompt set for the Nemotron-3 evaluation plan and any future RAG regression work. Each prompt has automated pass/fail rules. Sources: NEXT-STEPS.md (TAS-vs-PSFP failure trail), test-rag.ps1 (Vitis HLS smoke), project-state-2026-05 memory (register / clause lookup happy paths). See scripts/benchmark/run.ps1 and score.ps1.
$rule_semantics: expected_citations is an AND list of rules; each rule passes when ANY citation in the response matches both fileName_contains AND section_contains (substring, case-insensitive). currently_failing flags prompts the baseline is expected to fail — score script compares deltas. max_latency_s is a soft cap; over runs as a warning, not a failure.

prompts.question: Is TAS the same as a PSFP stream gate, does it have an IPV?
prompts.description: Contrastive: PSFP-dominated vocabulary; expect TAS-defining clauses recalled and PSFP/IPV correctly distinguished.

prompts.question: Explain the differences between TAS, PSFP, and ATS in IEEE 802.1Q.
prompts.description: Contrastive: all three mechanisms named explicitly. Stronger first-stage recall expected vs tas-vs-psfp-1; still needs TAS clauses cited.
prompts.source: NEXT-STEPS.md unresolved failure case, easier-phrasing variant

prompts.question: What does Clause 12.29 of IEEE 802.1Q-2022 specify?
prompts.description: Retrieval regression guard — explicit clause number in the prompt should always recall §12.29 chunks.

prompts.question: What does pragma HLS pipeline do in Vitis HLS, and what options does it accept?
prompts.description: AMD lookup regression guard -- well-known Vitis HLS pragma lookup against ug1399. (Original prompt asked about SCHED 200-880, which is a warning code, not a pragma; corrected after baseline run revealed the conflation.)

prompts.question: What does register 0x04 in the AXI Interrupt Controller do?
prompts.description: Register-by-hex-offset lookup; tests hybrid (BM25+dense) recall on exact alphanumeric tokens. Fast profile because regression risk is in retrieval, not generation depth.

prompts.question: What is the value assigned to the SCRPT_FOOBAR_42 register in the AMD AXI Interrupt Controller, and on what page of the datasheet is it documented?
prompts.description: Abstention guard. SCRPT_FOOBAR_42 is a fabricated register that exists nowhere in the corpus AND can't be filled in by general training knowledge. Under RAG_GROUNDING=augmented the model is permitted to add tagged general knowledge for source gaps, but here there's no plausible general knowledge to lean on -- so it should still abstain or explicitly admit no coverage. Original prompt ('What is the capital of France?') was a poor test under augmented grounding because the model could correctly answer from general knowledge.
prompts.source: Grounding guarantee from app/server.js ABSTAIN constant
